capabilities: sync the vault across devices via the user's Google Drive, OneDrive, or Dropbox
process only changed files instead of rescanning the whole vault
resolve edit conflicts with auto merge, prefer local, or duplicate strategies
connect through a custom OAuth app per provider
run manual sync via a command or status-bar icon
extras: README warns against running another sync tool on the same vault, against opening the managed cloud folder as a vault, and documents a Google Drive limitation where files added on the cloud side are invisible unless a custom OAuth app with full Drive scope is used; notes that OAuth tokens are stored in Obsidian's secret storage accessible to other plugins, and recommends backing up the vault.
motivation: The README opens with 'Like air, sync should simply be there' — sync should be invisible and require nothing to start, watch, or manage.
problem: Obsidian's built-in Sync is a paid service and there is no built-in way to sync a vault across devices using the user's existing cloud storage.

requires.name: Google Drive, OneDrive, or Dropbox account
custom OAuth app registered with the provider (needed for OneDrive work/school accounts or cloud-side Drive files)

summary: Vault sync plugin that keeps notes in step across devices through the user's own Google Drive, OneDrive, or Dropbox storage.
